generation_rules.procurement: one task per demanded physical unit; t=0; suppliers uncapacitated
generation_rules.purchase_cost: integer base UniformInteger(5,18) plus Uniform(0,10), four decimal places
generation_rules.assembly_graph: each subassembly chooses 0..2 predecessors among smaller local indices; final assembly waits for every subassembly sink
generation_rules.processing_time: base Uniform(4,12) subassembly or Uniform(10,20) final, multiplied by Uniform(.75,1.25), four decimals
generation_rules.sharing: only same product type and component identity; each type template replicated 1/2/3 times
generation_rules.time_noise: no additional run-level noise; generated lead times are fixed input
generation_rules.industrial_status: independent synthetic instances, not industrial data
